title: Compass Drift Ledger Entry
description: One build session's capture record. Written by `npm run log` (scripts/compass-log.mjs) into drift-log/entries/<ISO-timestamp>__<designer>__<slug>.json. This ledger is the machine-readable truth the audit loop reads; Slack is informal overflow only.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC time the entry was logged.

designer.description: Who ran the build. Defaults to `git config user.name`, overridable with --designer.

tool.description: Generation tool used for the build.

compassVersion.description: Compass package version at build time (read from package.json).

source.description: What drove the build: Figma frame URL or a one-line prompt summary.

targetFiles.description: Repo-relative paths of files created/changed by this build. Auto-captured from git, overridable with --files.

componentsUsed.description: Kebab-case names of Compass ui/ components imported by the target files (e.g. "card", "toggle-group"). Auto-inferred from `@/components/ui/<name>` imports.

assumptions.description: The pasted "What I assumed" block, one item per assumption. Empty array is valid (a clean build with no assumptions is still worth logging).

category.description: Suggested vocabulary (not enforced, so capture never blocks): styling | spacing | component-choice | content | behavior | token | uncategorized.

gitHead.description: Optional: git HEAD commit hash at log time. Used by the next `compass log` run to auto-diff changed files since this entry.

demo.description: Optional: true marks a sample/demo entry that tooling and Detect runs must ignore.
